# Synthetic catalog

## Generative AI

  * [Fixture Models](https://example.test/models) - Free hosted model inference API with 2,000 requests per month and explicit rate limits.
  * [Fixture Agent](https://example.test/agent) - Open-source platform for building AI agents and evaluating prompts.
  * [Fixture Vectors](https://example.test/vectors) - Free vector search and embeddings for small AI projects.

## Major Cloud Providers

  * [Fixture Compute](https://example.test/compute) - Free virtual machine and notebook with limited GPU hours.

## Education

  * [Fixture Course](https://example.test/course) - Free course about machine learning.
